Детектор ONNX Runtime для ViON. Распозна: ONNX Runtime detector for ViON. Object detection, face detection and recognition, license plate reading (OCR) and CLIP semantic search.
Модель CLIP для эмбеддингов семантическо: CLIP model for the semantic search, shared by all cameras. After you change it, the recordings have to be reindexed.
Модель, преобразующая лицо в вектор, общ: Model used to recognize faces, shared by all cameras. After you change it, the saved faces are recalculated.
Индекс(ы) GPU для CUDA; для нескольких G: GPU index(es) for CUDA; separate several GPUs with commas (for example "0" or "0,1"). Each device works on its own, so detection runs on all GPUs in parallel.
Оборудование, на котором сейчас выполняе: Hardware the loaded models are currently running on.

Очистить локальный кэш моделей и заново: Delete the downloaded models and download the current ones again.
